parameters.name: message
parameters.value:
={{ $('Information Extractor').first().json.output.language === 'en'
  ? `Hi ${$('Edit Fields').first().json.name}!
Based on your bill (Rs ${$('Calculation').first().json.bill}):

Solar system: ${$('Calculation').first().json.kw} kW
Estimated cost: Rs ${$('Calculation').first().json.total.toLocaleString('en-US')}

This is an approximate estimate.`
    : `Assalam O Alaikum ${$('Edit Fields').first().json.name}!
Aapke bill (Rs ${$('Calculation').first().json.bill}) ke hisaab se:

Solar system: ${$('Calculation').first().json.kw} kW
Estimated cost: Rs ${$('Calculation').first().json.total.toLocaleString('en-US')}

Yeh approximate estimate hai.` }}

parameters.name: message
parameters.value: ={{ $('Information Extractor').first().json.output.language === 'en'   ? `Hi! To prepare your estimate, please tell us your monthly electricity bill, your city, and what appliances you run (AC, fridge, fans). Example: My bill is 50000, in Bahawalpur, 3 ACs and 2 fridges`   : `Assalam o Alaikum! Estimate ke liye apna monthly bijli ka bill, city aur kya kya chalta hai (AC, fridge, fans) batayein. Jaise: Mera bill 50000 hai, Bahawalpur mein, 3 AC aur 2 fridge hain` }}

attributes.name: bill
attributes.description: Monthly electricity bill in PKR. Leave empty if the customer did not mention a bill. Never guess.

attributes.name: load_details
attributes.description: appliances such as AC, fridge, fans

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language the customer wrote in. Return "en" if English, "ur" if Roman Urdu or Urdu.

parameters.jsonOutput:
={
  "lead_id": "{{ $('Append row in sheet').first().json.lead_id }}",
  "name": "{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.name }}",
  "phone": "{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.chatId.replace('@c.us','') }}",
  "city": "{{ $('Information Extractor').first().json.output.city }}",
  "kw": {{ $('Calculation').first().json.kw }},
  "panels": {{ $('Calculation').first().json.panels }},
  "inverter": {{ $('Calculation').first().json.inverter }},
  "structure": {{ $('Calculation').first().json.structure }},
  "installation": {{ $('Calculation').first().json.installation }},
  "net_metering": {{ $('Calculation').first().json.net_metering }},
  "total": {{ $('Calculation').first().json.total }},
  "language": "{{ $('Information Extractor').first().json.output.language }}"
}

categories.description: customer wants to proceed, asks for a site visit or more details, or says yes (e.g. "haan karwa do", "yes, I'm interested", "send details")
says the price is high, asks for a discount, or wants time to think (e.g. "bohat mehnga hai", "too expensive", "let me think")
says no, asks to stop (e.g. "nahi chahiye", "not interested", "don't message me")

customer gives a new or changed bill, wants more or fewer panels, a bigger or smaller system, or a new estimate (e.g. "mera bill kam ho gaya", "I want to add more solar", "estimate again for 30000 bill")
